posts.content_md:
My latest bit of holography related technical ephemera is this 1986 Newport HC-1000 holographic camera system. Included are all necessary cables, the manual, and their thermoplastic recording system, but there's an interface box that's missing. There's probably a 15mW He-Ne under the deck. I can't wait to dig under the baseplate and clean it all up. We all saw it in the catalog. I'm really happy to snagged one intact.

posts.content_md: Hey Bob, Yea i hacked my HC1000 into pieces as soon as it arrived ! i think mine was complete so if theres any pieces you might be missing let me know. my film holder seems complete and even has a newport check up list where the Technitican states "it still make a good hologram"
